instruction:
Create a complete n8n workflow configuration that integrates OpenAI embeddings with Qdrant for semantic search.

Analysis shows 2 workflows ready: Semantic Search Pipeline (wf_003), Document Classification (wf_004).
Generate complete n8n JSON workflow definition with:
1. Input node for documents/queries
2. OpenAI embedding node (text-embedding-3-small)
3. Document chunking (max 512 tokens)
4. Qdrant vector DB connection (host: 172.17.0.1:6333, collection: documents)
5. Similarity search with threshold 0.7
6. Results formatting and output
7. Error handling nodes

Return as importable n8n JSON workflow.
